title: Vector spaces, subspaces, span and independence
description: The vector-space axioms in plain words, subspaces (and non-examples), span, linear independence and the column space.

title: Basis, dimension, coordinates and change of basis
description: Bases and dimension, rank-nullity, coordinates with respect to a basis, the change-of-basis matrix and similar matrices.

title: Orthogonality and orthogonal projection
description: Orthogonal and orthonormal bases, orthogonal matrices (Q^T Q = I), the orthogonal complement and the projection matrix A (A^T A)^-1 A^T.

title: Gram-Schmidt, QR and least squares via QR
description: Gram-Schmidt (classical and modified), A = QR, solving least squares by back-substitution and why this is more stable than the normal equations.
